description: specled_-dn4.9 re-derived item 1 after dn4.5: formatter.ex and coverage_triangulation.ex still need one shared module-to-source/repo-relative resolver, but doing it inside SpecLedEx.Coverage added public API and tripped api-boundary attestation. Revisit with an internal module/file explicitly scoped for this helper or another design that does not widen public API. Evidence: full mix test failed guard_ergonomics_attestation_test until the public helper was removed; both private copies were kept non-loading via :code.is_loaded/1.

comments.text: SCOPE ADDITION from the specled_-dn4.9 audit (2026-07-26T00:25:30Z): source_to_binary/1 is now duplicated in BOTH lib/specled_ex/coverage/formatter.ex and lib/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation.ex, growing the very duplication this ticket is chartered to remove. Fold it into this ticket's scope alongside repo_relative_path/1 and repo_relative_source_path/1 — that is now three private copies of shared resolver logic across the two modules.

Note from specled_-ygi: that ticket added a fourth byte-identical copy of the repo-relative source helper (now: Coverage.Formatter.repo_relative_path/1, CoverageTriangulation.repo_relative_source_path/1, Mix.Tasks.Spec.Triangle.repo_relative_source/1, Review.CoverageClosure.repo_relative_source/1). All four must stay in lockstep for the path-identity joins to hold; nothing enforces it. When consolidating the coverage source resolver, fold all four into the shared home (verifier suggested SpecLedEx.Coverage.Paths).

ADMISSION VERIFICATION (specled_-k6s, 2026-07-27)
Cold fresh-context verifier run against the epic base tree (feat/specled_-td7-self-identifying-descriptors @ e81f9f98).

VERDICT: still_applicable   EFFORT: medium
Mandate confirmed still applicable as written; no narrowing needed.

== SCOPED REMAINING WORK ==
Full mandate remains. Nothing has landed.

1. Create `lib/specled_ex/coverage/paths.ex`, module `SpecLedEx.Coverage.Paths`, with `@moduledoc false` (precedent: lib/specled_ex/coverage/arming.ex:2 — an unlisted, undocumented internal module that carries an `implementation` binding but is absent from coverage_capture.spec.md's `surface:` list, so a new internal module needs no spec surface entry). It must NOT be added to any `realized_by:` block. Suggested API (exact names free, but keep both return shapes so no call site changes behavior):
   - `def to_binary(source)` — charlist -> `List.to_string/1`, binary -> itself (replaces both `source_to_binary/1` copies).
   - `def repo_relative(path) :: String.t() | nil` — the `File.cwd!() |> Path.expand()` / `Path.expand(path, root)` / `String.starts_with?(absolute, root <> "/")` body; non-binary -> nil.
   - `def repo_relative_list(path) :: [String.t()]` — `case repo_relative(path) do nil -> []; p -> [p] end` (the list shape copies 3 and 4 need).
   - `def module_source(module, load?)` — `load?: false` uses `:code.is_loaded/1` (current formatter/triangulation semantics), `load?: true` uses `Code.ensure_loaded/1` (current closure/triangle semantics). Do NOT silently unify the loading semantics: coverage_closure.ex:136 and spec.triangle.ex:452 still call `Code.ensure_loaded`, and specled_-b23 item 2 is explicitly about the `Code.ensure_loaded`-fails posture of `binding_present?`. If you do unify, that is a behavior change requiring the `specled.triangulation.v1_file_level_path_identity` statement to be extended and coordinated with specled_-b23.

2. Delete and re-point, preserving the exact current return shapes:
   - lib/specled_ex/coverage/formatter.ex:274-286 (delete `source_to_binary/1`, `repo_relative_path/1`); rewrite `source_file/1` (:260-272) to call `Paths.module_source(module, false)`. Keep returning `String.t() | nil`.
   - lib/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation.ex:449-461 (delete both helpers); rewrite `module_source_file/1` (:434-446) to `Paths.module_source(mod, false)`; rewrite the direct call at :388 to `Paths.repo_relative(r.file)`. Keep `String.t() | nil`.
   - lib/specled_ex/review/coverage_closure.ex:135-165 — collapse `mfa_source_file/1` + `repo_relative_source/1` onto `Paths.module_source(mod, true)` wrapped by `Paths.repo_relative_list/1`. Must still return `[]` (never nil, never an absolute path) for out-of-repo or unloadable modules — `closure_files` and `binding_present?` at :137-141 depend on it. Reduce the 5-line duplicated comment at :151-155 to a one-line pointer at the new home.
   - lib/mix/tasks/spec.triangle.ex:451-481 — identical treatment; comment at :468-471 likewise reduced.

3. Hard constraint: do NOT add any public function to `SpecLedEx.Coverage`, `SpecLedEx.Coverage.Formatter`, `SpecLedEx.CoverageTriangulation`, `SpecLedEx.Review.CoverageClosure`, or `Mix.Tasks.Spec.Triangle`. All five are api_boundary-baselined (bare module or MFA) in .spec/realization_hashes.json; a new export changes `hash_module_head_union/2` for the bare-module ones and drifts the baseline — that is exactly the failure dn4.5 hit. Removing PRIVATE functions from those modules does not change the head-union hash, so this refactor needs no `.spec/realization_hashes.json` edit.

4. Add `test/specled_ex/coverage/paths_test.exs` pinning: charlist and binary inputs; absolute in-repo path -> repo-relative; out-of-repo absolute -> `nil` / `[]`; already-relative path -> unchanged; non-binary -> `nil` / `[]`; unloadable module -> `nil` / `[]` under both `load?` modes. This is the mechanical lockstep enforcement the second ticket comment asks for.

== EXPECTED TOUCHES ==
lib/specled_ex/coverage/paths.ex, lib/specled_ex/coverage/formatter.ex, lib/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation.ex, lib/specled_ex/review/coverage_closure.ex, lib/mix/tasks/spec.triangle.ex, test/specled_ex/coverage/paths_test.exs, CHANGELOG.md

== RISK NOTES ==
REALIZATION HASH: no `.spec/realization_hashes.json` change is expected, and any diff there is a red flag. Verified mechanism: lib/specled_ex/realization/api_boundary.ex:159-160 -> lib/specled_ex/realization/canonical.ex:176-186 hashes only `discover_module_exports/2` (public exports), so deleting private helpers from formatter.ex / coverage_triangulation.ex / coverage_closure.ex / spec.triangle.ex leaves `"SpecLedEx.Coverage.Formatter"` (:219), `"SpecLedEx.CoverageTriangulation.*"` (:331-350), `"SpecLedEx.Review.CoverageClosure.build_v2/2"`, `"Mix.Tasks.Spec.Triangle.run/1"` unchanged. Adding even one public function to any of them drifts the baseline AND fails test/integration/guard_ergonomics_attestation_test.exs:57-58.

MISLEADING SPEC PROSE — read this before trusting the tree: .spec/specs/branch_guard.spec.md:11 asserts "A bare-module entry hashes the whole file, so an edit anywhere in `coverage.ex` ... legitimately drifts this subject's realization hash". That contradicts `hash_module_head_union/2` (public-export union, not whole file) at canonical.ex:176-186. An implementer who believes that sentence will conclude this refactor is impossible. The sentence is out of scope for dn4.12 but is a live false-claim candidate for the td7 sweep.

FILE-TOUCH GUARD: this edits four files that ARE on subject surfaces — formatter.ex on `specled.coverage_capture` (.spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md:97) and coverage_triangulation.ex / review/coverage_closure.ex / mix/tasks/spec.triangle.ex on `specled.triangulation` (.spec/specs/triangulation.spec.md:32-34) — with no spec-requirement change. Expect `branch_guard` missing-subject-update findings on `specled.coverage_capture` and `specled.triangulation`; clear them with Spec-Drift info trailers (repo convention, per specled_-ygi's landed record), not by weakening a requirement. The new paths.ex maps to no subject (arming.ex precedent) and should be silent.

ORDERING: no ticket must land first. But specled_-b23 item 2 renegotiates the `Code.ensure_loaded`-failure posture of `binding_present?` in the very producers this ticket rewrites (spec.triangle.ex / coverage_closure.ex `mfa_source_file/1`) and edits `specled.triangulation.v1_file_level_path_identity` (.spec/specs/triangulation.spec.md:244-256) plus test/mix/tasks/spec_triangle_test.exs. If both land in one PR, land dn4.12 FIRST as a pure no-behavior-change refactor, then let b23 add its aggregate-envelope test and requirement wording on top; otherwise b23's new test will be written against a helper that dn4.12 then moves.

specled_-zd8 edits lib/specled_ex/coverage/formatter.ex `flush/1` (starts at :288) and `record_inventory/2` — `flush/1` begins two lines after `repo_relative_path/1` ends at :286, so the two diffs are textually adjacent in the same hunk. Sequence them, do not parallelize.

specled_-npo edits `specled.coverage_capture.envelope_meta` in .spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md; dn4.12 should need no spec-file edit at all, so the collision is only if dn4.12's Spec-Drift handling is done by touching that spec instead of a trailer.

GATE: verify with `mix spec.check --no-run-commands` plus targeted `mix test test/specled_ex/coverage/formatter_test.exs test/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation_test.exs test/specled_ex/review/coverage_closure_test.exs test/mix/tasks/spec_triangle_test.exs test/integration/guard_ergonomics_attestation_test.exs`. The attestation test is the specific canary for the public-API constraint. Per my prior experience with this repo, tagged_tests verification legs are timing-flaky under load — a single red run there is not proof of regression.

SCOPE CONTRACT (orchestrator, specled_-k6s — 2026-07-27)

Authoritative for mechanical scope checks. Supplements, does not replace, the
ADMISSION VERIFICATION comment's mandate (items 1-4), which is what you implement.

## Allowed touches
- `lib/specled_ex/coverage/paths.ex` (new, `@moduledoc false`, NOT added to any
  `realized_by:` block and NOT added to any spec `surface:` list — arming.ex precedent)
- `lib/specled_ex/coverage/formatter.ex`
- `lib/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation.ex`
- `lib/specled_ex/review/coverage_closure.ex`
- `lib/mix/tasks/spec.triangle.ex`
- `test/specled_ex/coverage/paths_test.exs` (new)
- `.spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md`, `.spec/specs/triangulation.spec.md` —
  spec co-change is AUTHORIZED, and takes precedence over Out of Scope, ONLY if
  the gate cannot be cleared by a `Spec-Drift:` trailer. Expected posture is a
  trailer, not a spec edit; justify any spec edit in the completion record.

## Out of Scope (files)
- `CHANGELOG.md` — the ADMISSION comment lists it under expected touches, but the
  ORCHESTRATOR OVERRIDES THAT: the 0.11.0 section is consolidated once at the end
  of the epic. Do not append. This is the one place the admission comment is stale.
- `VERSION`, `.spec/state.json`.
- `.spec/realization_hashes.json` — MUST NOT CHANGE. Any diff here means you added
  a public export. Stop, revert the export, and report; never regenerate the baseline.
- `.spec/specs/branch_guard.spec.md` — its line 11 sentence about bare-module
  hashing is a known false claim and is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for this ticket.
  Do not believe it and do not fix it.
- Every file not listed under Allowed touches.

## Out of Scope (intent)
- HARD CONSTRAINT: add NO public function to `SpecLedEx.Coverage`,
  `SpecLedEx.Coverage.Formatter`, `SpecLedEx.CoverageTriangulation`,
  `SpecLedEx.Review.CoverageClosure`, or `Mix.Tasks.Spec.Triangle`. All five are
  api_boundary-baselined. Removing PRIVATE functions is safe; adding a public one
  drifts the baseline. This is the ticket's defining constraint.
- Do NOT unify the `:code.is_loaded/1` vs `Code.ensure_loaded/1` semantics. Keep
  `load?: false` and `load?: true` distinct. Unifying is a behavior change owned
  by specled_-b23.
- This is a pure no-behavior-change refactor. Every rewritten call site must
  preserve its exact current return shape (`String.t() | nil` for the two
  `module_source` sites, `[]`-never-nil for the closure/triangle sites).
- No new dependencies; `mix.exs` / `mix.lock` unchanged.
- Do not weaken spec prose or add a false `decisions:` link to quiet branch-guard.

## Verification (change-scoped, run-until-green; host mix, no compose)
1. `mix compile --warnings-as-errors`
2. `mix test test/specled_ex/coverage/paths_test.exs test/specled_ex/coverage/formatter_test.exs test/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation_test.exs test/specled_ex/review/coverage_closure_test.exs test/mix/tasks/spec_triangle_test.exs test/integration/guard_ergonomics_attestation_test.exs`
   — `guard_ergonomics_attestation_test.exs` is the canary for the public-API constraint.
3. `git diff --stat -- .spec/realization_hashes.json` must be EMPTY.
4. `mix spec.check --no-run-commands`

Do NOT run bare `mix spec.check` and do NOT run the full suite. The orchestrator
owns whole-system proof at the merge gate and PR CI. Note: tagged_tests
verification legs are timing-flaky under load; re-run a single red leg serially
before treating it as real.
